assetImport.namePlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the packaged name ({kind}; change it here if it clashes)
assetImport.publishNow: Release a version immediately after importing
assetImport.publishHint: Off by default: what you install is a draft, while production entry points (endpoint / MCP / tool calls) use the released version. Disabled or deprecated entities cannot be released, and the reason is shown here.
assetImport.desc: Choose a {kind} package previously created with "Export". Once installed it belongs to this tenant and has nothing to do with the platform marketplace; if the name already exists you will be asked once before overwriting the existing {kind}.
assetImport.errorSuggested: {msg} (suggested name {name} has been filled in; you can retry directly)
assetImport.overwriteDetailAgent: Overwriting replaces its files, config, private skills, skill bindings and the three permission switches (super agent / unrestricted tools / discover unbound skills) according to the package.
assetImport.overwriteDetailSkill: Overwriting replaces its body and attachments, description/metadata, command config and tool requirements according to the package; unreleased draft changes of this skill will be lost. Visibility grants (which agents may use it) stay as they are.
assetImport.overwriteDetailWorkflow: Overwriting replaces only the draft (graph / variables / limits). Released versions, exposed endpoints and breakpoints stay as they are — release a new version in the editor to make the new content live.
assetImport.overwriteDetailCustomTool: Overwriting replaces the scripts and the TOOL.json contract according to the package. Existing config values and the enabled state stay as they are (config is credentials and the package's config is empty); review the scripts before using it again.

assetMarket.emptyMarket: Nothing to install: either it is already installed, or the provider has not passed platform review yet
assetMarket.remoteTip: These assets are not in the local market yet: the platform only grants which sites you can see and does not import them for you. They are downloaded into this machine as platform assets only when you click Pull and install; if the other site requires review, they land in the local pending queue first and are really installed once the platform approves.
assetMarket.peerTruncated: (showing the first {shown}; narrow it down with search)
assetMarket.peerEmpty: No assets to pull from this site
assetMarket.remoteEmpty: The platform has not enabled remote markets for this tenant (or the other side is unreachable)
assetMarket.mineTip: Listing publishes a snapshot: other tenants can install it and get their own copy, unaffected by your later edits. Listing the same name again bumps the version by 1 (tenants that require platform review go back to pending).
assetMarket.installsTip: Installing copies: once installed, the target entity has nothing to do with the snapshot, and later edits by the source tenant do not sync over. "New snapshot available" only means the provider listed it again, so reinstall and merge the changes yourself.
assetMarket.detailSkills: Skills (matched by name in the target tenant):
assetMarket.detailPrivateSkills: Private skills {names} are not migrated with the asset (this version only ships the body)
assetMarket.installNamePlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the asset name
assetMarket.installNameHint: Installs as a new entity; a name clash suggests another name (nothing is renamed silently).
assetMarket.installStatusHint: A disabled tool is never called and cannot be released; enable it once you have reviewed it.
assetMarket.installPublishNow: Release a version immediately after installing
assetMarket.installPublishHint: Off by default: what you install is a draft, while production entry points use the released version. Disabled or deprecated entities cannot be released, and the reason is written into the install notes.
assetMarket.installAgentHint: The agent's super-agent, unrestricted-tools and skill-discovery switches do not travel with the asset (they are all off after installing); who may call the agent has to be configured again under Agents → Call grants.
assetMarket.installWorkflowHint: A workflow only carries the graph and variables, not references to models / tools / sub-flows: reconfigure them item by item in the editor after installing. Credential environment variables (api_key etc.) were cleared when it was listed.
assetMarket.listingPickPlaceholder: Pick one entity of this tenant
assetMarket.listingHint: Protected entities (main / *-authoring …), super agents and deprecated entities can all be listed. Private skills cannot be listed on their own — list the agent that owns them and they are packaged with it. What gets packaged is a content copy: super permissions, unrestricted tools, skill discovery, call grants and private ownership do not travel; custom tools it depends on are packaged along with their body (enabled by default).
assetMarket.listingVisibleHint: Listed assets are visible by default: if this tenant is exempt from review, other tenants can see and install them right away; if the platform requires review, they go to pending first and only become visible after approval.
assetMarket.loadListFailed: Failed to load the asset list
assetMarket.pulledPending: Pulled; waiting for platform review — this entry becomes installable once approved
assetMarket.pulledReview: Pulled; it can be installed once the platform approves it
assetMarket.conflictTitle: An asset with this name already exists
assetMarket.conflictBody: This machine already has an asset named "{name}" v{build} ({status}); most likely the other side withdrew it and listed it again. Overwriting bumps the local entry to the upstream snapshot, and tenants that installed it need to reinstall.
assetMarket.clearInstallsBody:
Clear all {n} install record(s) of this tenant?
Only the records are deleted; installed skills / tools / agents are not uninstalled, and these assets show up as not installed in the local market again.
assetMarket.removeInstallBody:
Delete the install record of "{asset}"?
Only the record is deleted; the installed "{name}" is not uninstalled, and the asset shows up as not installed in the local market again.
assetMarket.detailLoadSoft: Failed to load details; showing list information only
assetMarket.conflictSuggested: {msg}; suggested name {name} has been filled in — confirm and click Install again
assetMarket.listedOk: Listed — other tenants can install it now
assetMarket.deleteAssetBody: Delete "{name}" (current status: {status})? The snapshot files are removed too and cannot be restored.
assetMarket.clearMineBody:
Clear all {n} unlisted asset(s) of this tenant (draft / pending / rejected / delisted)?
The snapshot files are removed too and cannot be restored; listed assets are kept (delist them on the platform first).
assetMarket.draftDeleteBody: Delete the draft "{name}"? The snapshot files are removed too and cannot be restored.
assetMarket.withdrawBody: Withdraw "{name}"? It goes back to draft and other tenants can no longer see it.

assetTransfer.publishUnsupported: This asset type cannot be released right after importing
assetTransfer.publishFailedInline: {verb} completed, but releasing a version failed: {msg} (you can release it manually from the version panel)

assetDep.existingOverwrite: {verb}: this tenant already has a {kind} named "{name}"; you will be asked to confirm before it is overwritten
assetDep.existingRename: {verb}: this tenant already has a {kind} named "{name}"; please choose a different name
assetDep.noDeps: The package declares no external dependencies
